privacy: Redacted methodological case patterns derived from researcher-controlled work. They omit private program text, credentials, and third-party data.

cases.title: Incomplete option-terminator fix leaves a repository command path injectable

cases.title: Approval UI hides consequential fields while attachment handling bypasses file policy
